h1: Thumrin Thana Hotel — the landmark high-rise everyone in Trang knows
intro: Ask anyone in Trang where the big hotel in the middle of town is, and almost all of them will say Thumrin Thana — the tall building on Huayyod Road that's been open since 1997 and still hosts the town's weddings, banquets and business travellers today. It's a 4-star city hotel with 289 rooms; the selling points are spacious rooms, city views from the upper floors, indoor and outdoor pools, and a central location within reach of the markets and railway station. From approx. ฿1,300/night, scoring 8.4 from real guest reviews.

body.html: Thumrin Thana is a long-standing hotel in the Thumrin group that has been part of Trang for decades. The building is a distinctive high-rise on Huayyod Road, with 289 rooms split into Standard, Deluxe, Premier Deluxe and Junior Suite. Open since 1997, it's not a new hotel, but it is the town's main hotel — the one Trang locals use for weddings, banquets and hosting visiting guests across generations. That familiarity and reliability is something reviews mention often.

The most-praised feature is the spacious rooms. Many reviews say the rooms are larger than comparably priced hotels in town, with big bathrooms that have both a bathtub and a separate shower, strong water pressure and a comfortable bed. Upper-floor rooms get open city views over Trang — guests on floors 12 to 14 often post photos of the view in their reviews. In-room amenities are complete: flat-screen TV, fridge, minibar and safe.

"We had a room on the 14th floor with a wide-open city view, the room was bigger than expected, the bed was comfortable, and the bathroom had a separate tub and shower — great value for a hotel right in the centre of town."

Facilities are well-rounded for a city hotel. There are indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a sauna, a gym and a massage spa. On the dining side there's plenty of choice: the Trang Thana Coffee Shop serving Thai and international food, the Numbu Japanese restaurant, and The Terrace with live music in the evenings. The lobby is large and parking is easy — a point self-drivers particularly appreciate.

Location is another advantage. It sits in the centre of Trang on Huayyod Road, about 5 minutes' drive from Trang railway station and within reach of the town's markets and restaurants. The Trang clock tower and old-town quarter aren't far. Trang is famous for its food — morning dim sum and roast pork especially — and from here you can easily head out to find it. Trang Airport (TST) is about 15 minutes away, making it suitable for both leisure and business trips.

Things to know before booking. Because it has been open for more than 25 years, the building and parts of the decor look dated and due for a refresh. Reviews mention thin walls — on nights with a banquet or live music you may hear it — some rooms have a musty smell, and the odd outlet or drain needs maintenance. Some older reviews also report that in-room Wi-Fi can be unreliable, so check with the hotel first. Overall it's strong on space and location, but it isn't a sleek new hotel.

In short, Thumrin Thana suits people who want spacious rooms, a central location, full facilities and good value, for both sightseeing and work. Standard rooms start around ฿1,300/night, rising to roughly ฿2,000–3,000 for Deluxe and Junior Suite rooms in peak periods or when events are on. For anyone who can accept the age of the building in exchange for the space and the location, it remains a default choice in Trang town.

honestSummary: Thumrin Thana is the best pick for anyone who wants spacious rooms, a central Trang location, full facilities and good value — for sightseeing or for work, and the town hotel locals trust. But accept that the building has been open for over 25 years, the decor looks dated, walls are thin, and it isn't a sleek new hotel.
honestChecks: If you want a sleek, modern hotel — this building is over 25 years old and parts of the decor are due for a refresh → for something newer, look at a recent boutique hotel in town instead.
If you're a light sleeper — walls are thin and on some nights a banquet or live music carries into the rooms → ask for a high floor away from the event spaces and bring earplugs.
If you need reliable in-room Wi-Fi to work — some reviews report the in-room signal can be unstable → check with the hotel first, or keep a mobile-data backup ready.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Thumrin Thana Hotel Trang

faq.q: Where is Thumrin Thana Hotel and what's nearby?
faq.a: It's at 69/8 Huayyod Road, Thap Thiang, in the centre of Trang town · about 5 minutes' drive from Trang railway station, within reach of the markets and restaurants on foot or a short ride · the clock tower and old town are close by · Trang Airport (TST) is around 15 minutes away.

faq.q: How much does Thumrin Thana Hotel cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: From around ฿1,300/night for a Standard room · Deluxe and Premier Deluxe around ฿1,700–2,200 · Junior Suite around ฿3,000 · prices move with the season and with events on, so compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Thumrin Thana Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's best for people who want spacious rooms, a central location, full facilities and good value, for both sightseeing and work · there are pools, a gym and easy parking, making it suitable for families, business travellers and self-drivers · if you specifically want a new, modern design, consider another option.

faq.q: Is the hotel old? Is there much noise?
faq.a: The hotel has been open since 1997, so the building and some of the decor look dated and due for a refresh · walls are fairly thin, and on nights with a banquet or live music you may hear it · asking for a high floor away from the event spaces and bringing earplugs helps.

faq.q: Which rooms have the best view, and what should I request?
faq.a: Upper-floor rooms (around floors 12–14) get open city views over Trang, the feature reviewers love most · ask for a Premier Deluxe or Junior Suite on a high floor, and mention you'd like a high floor with a city view when booking.
